english.note: Use this for sweeping or brushing loose material away from a surface or person.

exampleSentences.english: Please brush the crumbs off the table.
exampleSentences.traditional: 麻煩你掃走枱面啲麵包屑。
exampleSentences.jyutping: maa4 faan4 nei5 sou3 zau2 toi4 min6 di1 min6 baau1 sit3

english.note: Use this when something is swept away or removed completely and abruptly, rather than merely cleaned.

exampleSentences.english: The downpour can sweep all the rubbish off the beach in one go.
exampleSentences.traditional: 場暴雨將沙灘上啲垃圾一嘢掃走晒。
exampleSentences.jyutping: coeng4 bou6 jyu5 zoeng1 saa1 taan1 soeng6 di1 laap6 saap3 jat1 je5 sou3 zau2 saai3
